request.title: Keep the dashboard Appearance action readable at enlarged phone widths
request.description: The current dashboard browser screenshot at 360 pixels and 200-percent text shows the Appearance heading beside a button squeezed into a glyph-wide column. Phone rules set both flex children to full width without allowing the row to wrap.
request.expected_behavior: Keep the Appearance label and Customize theme or Done action readable, visible and keyboard accessible at phone and desktop widths without reducing text size or changing theme preferences.
request.source: .skill-tree/artifacts/ux-ui/dashboard-freshness/1793715437200725000/webkit-gryphy-light-360-200-dashboard-failed.png; app.css dashboard-appearance-head and phone child width rules.
request.priority_reason: The collapsed dashboard Appearance row obstructs current changed-route primary-action qualification and expands above the account status at enlarged phone text.
